modules.metric_semantics: Per supported card: average number of end-of-own-turn checkpoints through the stated turn at which the counter is available under the Step-E readiness model. Cards are not summed into a universal protection score.

assumptions: end-of-own-turn unspent mana is a proxy for mana held through the following opponent turn cycle
normal spell cost uses mana value rather than exact colored pips, so readiness is an upper bound when colors are constrained
readiness is opportunity count, not number of counters actually cast
spec.determinism: seeded paired v1.1 games; readiness is a deterministic function of the zone/mana trace
does_not_model: whether an opponent actually casts a legal/important target
activation costs for permanent counter abilities
limitations: Does not evaluate counterspell quality, target breadth or opponent pressure; scope is reported but not weighted.
models: turns by 4/6/8/10 on which a supported counterspell is in hand and normal-cost mana remains unspent
Fierce-Guardianship-style explicit 'control a commander -> cast without paying' readiness
supported activated counter abilities: battlefield-available turns (cost not reconstructed)

modules.metric_semantics: Per supported card: average number of end-of-own-turn checkpoints through the stated turn with reactive protection ready or static/activated protection active under Step-E semantics. Cards are not collapsed into a universal protection score.

assumptions: normal spell cost uses mana value rather than exact colored pips
active-turn/readiness counts are opportunities, not uses or prevented interactions
spec.determinism: seeded paired v1.1 games; readiness is a deterministic function of the zone/mana trace
does_not_model: whether protection has a valuable legal target
redirects/copies, bounce-as-protection, prevention, regeneration, protection-from-color, Teferi-style timing locks
limitations: Protection modes differ materially; this module reports availability only and does not claim a universal value conversion.
models: supported reactive protection spells: turns in hand with normal-cost mana left unspent
supported activated/static team/self protection permanents: battlefield-active turns
direct hexproof/indestructible/phase-out protection and explicit 'spells you control can't be countered'

evidence.note: Canonical-deck bounded Step-E module execution from the frozen development snapshot. Outputs are availability/friction evidence only; they do not decide a swap, bracket, or deck approval.

items.question: Can the list protect or force through a compact win under stack interaction?

modules.metric_semantics: Per supported permanent and per category only. Opponent extra-mana demand, blocked spells, blocked draws and static-lock activity remain separate; symmetric self-burden is explicit. No composite stax score is produced.

assumptions: three opponents; opponent spells per turn is swept over 1/2/3, noncreature share over 0.5/0.7/0.9, opponent cards drawn per turn over 1/2/3
if the permanent is present at your end step, its static text applies through the following opponent turn cycle
spell-tax mana is friction demanded, not mana actually paid; cap metrics are upper-bound prevented-event counts given the declared activity point
spec.determinism: seeded paired v1.1 battlefield trace plus closed-form declared opponent-activity grid
does_not_model: whether opponents can/will pay taxes, exact opponent mana curves, or which spells are most important
Trinisphere-style minimum total costs, dynamic per-spell taxes, type/color/subtype-specific locks outside supported families
resource denial, mana-base conversion, combat restrictions, graveyard replacement effects, or removal timing
a universal conversion between tax mana, blocked spells, blocked draws and static-lock uptime
limitations: Category metrics are intentionally not summed. M6 judgment must consider self-burden, asymmetry and commander-specific leverage.
Static-lock active rounds measure availability only; opponent dependence is handled later by bracket stress/red-team review.
models: fixed spell taxes on opponents or all players: opponent extra-mana demand range
cast-per-turn caps: opponent spells blocked range under declared spell-volume sensitivity
draw-per-turn caps: opponent draws blocked range under declared draw-volume sensitivity
supported static locks (search, cast-during-your-turn, artifact ETB tapped, activated-ability, untap, graveyard-cast, creature-ETB-trigger): active rounds only
symmetric effects retain an explicit self_burden flag; no composite score hides that cost
